archetypes.name: White-Black Lifegain
archetypes.plan: Build around Scholar of Athreos: Trade resources and gain life incrementally, then convert that life buffer into repeated drain and inevitability.

archetypes.name: Green-White Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Setessan Griffin: Target heroic creatures with efficient tricks, spread counters across the team, and win creature combat through growth.

archetypes.name: White-Blue Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Coastline Chimera: Target heroic creatures with Auras and tricks, protect the invested threat, and use evasion to close quickly.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Spells
archetypes.plan: Build around Crackling Triton: Cast cheap instants and sorceries to trigger spell payoffs while bounce and burn keep attackers connecting.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Graveyard
archetypes.plan: Build around Loathsome Catoblepas: Trade creatures and mill selectively so graveyard payoffs turn spent cards into a late-game advantage.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Control
archetypes.plan: Build around Returned Phalanx: Trade one-for-one early, defend with high-toughness creatures, and win after card advantage exhausts the opponent.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Minotaurs
archetypes.plan: Build around Deathbellow Raider: Curve Minotaurs into Rageblood Shaman and Kragma Warcaller, then use trample, haste, and attack bonuses to overwhelm blockers.

archetypes.name: Red-White Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Priest of Iroas: Target heroic attackers with tricks, remove key blockers, and turn one protected creature into a fast clock.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Monstrosity
archetypes.plan: Build around Agent of Horizons: Ramp and defend until large creatures can become monstrous, then use their upgraded bodies to overwhelm combat.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Monsters
archetypes.plan: Build around Satyr Hedonist: Curve mana acceleration into oversized threats, then grant trample or remove blockers to convert size into lethal damage.
